name: macOS Control Center
description: A macOS-inspired, modular grid Control Center: rounded quick-toggle tiles (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AirDrop), an MPRIS media card, a Night Light / Screen Recording / Focus row, brightness and volume slider cards, and an "Edit Controls" picker that adopts Quick Settings toggles from GNOME Shell and other extensions (Caffeine, GSConnect, ...) into the panel. Uses only public Shell/Clutter/St APIs and D-Bus (NetworkManager, BlueZ, MPRIS, SettingsDaemon, Screencast) plus Gvc for volume.
